title: Classify a missing repository path
userIntent: Read a path that does not exist and return a bounded public error without mutating the repository.

intendedBehavior: The repository reader returns an explicit missing-path failure.
behavioralInvariants: Missing files are not represented as empty successful reads.
regressionRisks: The caller receives ambiguous success or an unrelated filesystem error.

provenance.note: Shared failure behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
